1.steps:
1) From the Users>Guest Account, click the 'Add Guest' button to open the configure dialog;
2) Use the 'Generate' button to generate guest name and password automatically.
3) Go to the 'Guest Services' tab, check the boxes, and set the account,session expiration, and idle time.
4) Press OK, and make sure the guest is listed in Guest Account list.
5) Open the config dialog of it, verify all the settings isn't changed.
1.initial: PC1 connected to X0 interface of the DUT, the X1 interface connected to lab network which can access Internet; PC2 is a wireless client.
1.title: Create a guest user
1.result: Wlan guest user can be created successfully.

2.steps:
1) From the Users>Guest Account, click the trash icon behind a guest user 'test', verify a dialog popped up saying 'Are you sure you wish to delete the user test?'
2) Press OK, make sure the guest user is deleted
3) Check the check-box before another guest user 'test1', and then click the 'Delete' button, verify a dialog popped up saying 'Are you sure you wish to delete the selected entries?'
4) Press OK, make sure the selected guest user is deleted
5) From the CLI, type 'show tsr users' to show all the users, make sure the 2 guest user are not included in it
2.initial: PC1 connected to X0 interface of the DUT, the X1 interface connected to lab network which can access Internet; PC2 is a wireless client.
2.title: Deleting the guest user
2.result: The guest user can be deleted successfully.

13.steps:
1).From Users>Local Users, add multiple guest users manually
2).Export the TSR file with current preference
3).Open the TSR file, make sure all the guest users are listed in 'User Object Table' correctly
4).Add some new guest users and deleted some old guest users, and then export TSR file
5).Open the new TSR file, and make sure the information about guest users are updated correctly
13.initial: PC1 connected to X0 interface of the DUT.
13.title: Verify the TSR for the Guest Users created
13.result: TSR file is carrying correct Guest Users information.
